concerns.text: The core validation metric `delta_Suitability = mean(suitability_2050) – mean(suitability_2005‑2020)` (see step 6‑7 of the plan) is computed entirely from model predictions on the same set of occurrence points under two climate scenarios. This metric is therefore a deterministic function of the model’s own outputs and the climate rasters, not an independent ground‑truth or external observation. Using it to claim assessment of SDM reliability or niche non‑stationarity is circular: the analysis will inevitably detect a change whenever the climate inputs differ, regardless of whether the model’s forecasts are biologically accurate. No independent validation against observed future occurrences (or any other external benchmark) is performed, making the result true by definition rather than an empirical test.
